title: OAT3D: A Generative Model for 3D Shape- and Resolution-Free Structural Topology Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.29253v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Topology optimization determines how material should be distributed within a design domain to optimize structural performance under prescribed loads, supports, and constraints. The problems are highly nonconvex, and conventional solvers require repeated finite element analyses, making high-resolution 3D topology optimization computationally expensive. Data-driven approaches face an additional bottleneck: generating training datasets requires solving large numbers of these costly problems, so existing work in data-driven topology optimization primarily focuses on 2D problems. Large-scale 3D datasets remain scarce, and existing models remain limited in problem scale and boundary-condition diversity. Here, we introduce Optimize Any Topology-3D (OAT3D), a generative model for high-resolution 3D structural topology optimization. translated_title: OAT3D：一种面向三维形状无关、分辨率无关结构拓扑优化的生成模型
translated_abstract: 拓扑优化旨在确定材料应如何在一个设计域内分布，以在给定的载荷、支撑和约束条件下优化结构性能。这类问题高度非凸，传统求解器需要反复进行有限元分析，使得高分辨率的三维拓扑优化在计算上十分昂贵。数据驱动方法则面临另一个瓶颈：构建训练数据集需要求解大量此类高成本问题，因此现有的数据驱动拓扑优化研究主要集中在二维问题上。大规模三维数据集仍然稀缺，且现有模型在问题规模和边界条件多样性方面仍然受限。本文提出了 Optimize Any Topology-3D（OAT3D），一种用于高分辨率三维结构拓扑优化的生成模型。OAT3D 引入了一种新颖的稀疏问题编码来表示载荷与固定（约束）条件，并结合了稀疏体（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: OAT3D 提出了一种新颖的稀疏问题编码与生成模型相结合的方法，实现了不受形状和分辨率限制的高分辨率三维结构拓扑优化。
en_tdlr: OAT3D is a generative model with a novel sparse problem encoding that enables shape- and resolution-free, high-resolution 3D structural topology optimization.
